Subject: Recap + info request: VPC pilot, token volumes & environment needs

Hi Lisa — great to meet today. Quick recap and a small favor so we can size a Private/VPC pilot and produce an initial pricing sketch: 

1) Recap from our call
- Goal: host patient-facing summarization and triage models inside Helium's VPC for regulatory/data residency reasons.
- Pilot scope: 1 production environment serving patient messages + 1 staging; evaluation window 6–8 weeks.
- Key success metrics: median latency <300ms at 95th percentile, stable costs below internal threshold, no PHI egress outside your VPC.

2) Info we need to firm up pricing (can reply inline):
- Typical monthly token volume (estimate for month 1 and month 6) — include prompt+completion tokens if possible.
- Peak qps / 95th percentile request rate during business hours.
- Number of environments to run concurrently (prod, staging, dev, DR).
- Any target budget range or target $/1M tokens you'd like us to aim for (helps when we size reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go).
- Procurement timeline and contacts (procurement@helium-health.com?) for PO and legal.

3) Next steps
- If you can send the rough token numbers and environment count, I’ll run two pricing scenarios: (A) reserved-capacity + annual license, (B) lighter-weight per-1M token license for pilot. We’ll also call out support tiers and environment fees.

I’ve looped in Marissa who will help with the licensing matrix. Thanks — talk soon.

—

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Recap + info request: VPC pilot — Helium estimates (need pricing sketch)

Marissa / Sean / Karthik — forwarding Lisa's estimates from Helium. Highlights: 200M tokens/mo to start, 450M/mo by month 6, prod + DR required in-VPC, target pilot budget $6k–$12k/mo. Procurement contact copied.

Quick thoughts (brain dump):
- Unit economics target: if they want $6k–$12k for 200M tokens that implies $30–$60 per 1M tokens at pilot volumes. That is low for a fully private VPC with dedicated prod + DR unless we lean on a reserved capacity commitment.

Pricing structures to consider for the proposal:
A) Reserved-capacity license (recommended for prod+DR)
  - Annual license (node reservation) + predictable token tier pricing
  - Example: $60k/year license for a 2-node prod pool (includes DR standby), then $20 / 1M tokens over a 100M included tokens/mo baseline.
B) Capacity-light pilot (lower up-front)
  - Pilot subscription $6k–$12k/mo includes up to 200M tokens with Premium support add-on optional. Overages at $35 / 1M tokens.

Support tiers (to call out):
- Standard (included): business-hours support, access to console/logs, 7-day retention for traces.
- Premium (+$12k/year): 24x5 support, on-call escalation, faster SLA windows.
- Enterprise (+$35k/year): 24x7 SLA, quarterly on-site/remote review, priority capacity.

Env fees / infra mapping:
- Prod (dedicated): price-in driver due to isolation + HA.
- DR (standby): priced as a fraction of prod (e.g., 40% of prod node cost) if passive.
- Staging / Dev: can be shared and included at no extra baseline cost for pilot.

Ask: Marissa — can you sketch two concrete price cards (A & B) with line items: license, estimated monthly token cost at 200M and 450M, environment surcharge, and support additions? Sean — anything on SLA wording or network egress requirements we should flag to legal/proc? Karthik — any quick comments on how we might compress the pilot price for win-back?

—Jordan

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Nguyen <lisa@helium-health.com>, Kevin Park <kevin.park@helium-health.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@helium-health.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: VPC pilot — suggested pricing options and next steps

Lisa / Kevin — thanks again for the numbers. Attached is a concise pricing summary and two paths we recommend for the pilot. High level below so you can share with procurement.

Summary of your estimates (from your note):
- Month 1: ~200M tokens/month
- Month 6: ~450M tokens/month
- Required: Prod (dedicated) + DR (standby), staging/dev can be shared
- Pilot budget target: $6k–$12k/month

Option 1 — Pilot-friendly subscription (low up-front)
- Monthly pilot subscription: $9,500/month (includes up to 200M tokens)
- Overages: $35 per 1M tokens beyond 200M
- Support: Standard included; Premium support optional for +$12k/year
- Environments: Prod (included), DR standby priced at 35% of prod cost if activated
- Notes: This option is designed to fit the mid-point of your stated budget and keep procurement friction low; good for a short 6–8 week evaluation.

Option 2 — Reserved-capacity (lower unit economics at scale)
- Annual reserved license: $62,000/year for a 2-node reserved pool (prod + standby capacity accounted for)
- Monthly effective (amortized): ~$5,167/month + operational fees
- Included tokens baseline: 100M tokens/month; overage at $18 per 1M tokens
- Environments: Prod & DR covered in the reserved nodes; staging/dev shared
- Notes: At 450M/month this option produces substantially lower $/1M token. We can show a side-by-side in the attached spreadsheet.

Pilot recommendation: start with Option 1 to keep procurement moving, then move to Option 2 as monthly volume ramps. For a short-term incentive we can offer the first 3 months at $25 / 1M tokens on overages (applies if they exceed the 200M included tokens) — subject to an MOU.

Attachments:
- vpc_pricing_summary_helium_20261111.xlsx (pricing by line item)
- redwood_vpc_license_terms_v2.pdf (summary of license + support tiers)

Next steps:
1) If procurement wants a shorter SOW/quote, I can produce a one-page SOW and send via DocuSign.
2) Procurement/Legal can review the attached license terms — we’re happy to iterate.
3) If you’re open, we’ll schedule a short pricing review with Marissa to walk through the spreadsheet tomorrow.
